label: Drop the old Chat SDK state in schema "chat" and the search_path setting that pointed at it

execute.description: drop the Chat SDK tables in schema "chat"
drop the search_path setting on the database
execute.sql: DO $$ BEGIN EXECUTE format('ALTER DATABASE %I RESET search_path', current_database()); END $$

postcheck.description: verify schema "chat" is gone and the database sets no search_path
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'chat') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_db_role_setting AS s INNER JOIN pg_database AS d ON d.oid = s.setdatabase WHERE d.datname = current_database() AND s.setrole = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(s.setconfig) AS c WHERE c LIKE 'search_path=%')) AS "result"

  "cache_key" text NOT NULL,

  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "chat_state_cache_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("key_prefix", "cache_key")
)

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_class" AS "c" WHERE ("c"."oid" = to_regclass($1) AND ("c"."relkind" = $2 OR "c"."relkind" = $3))) AS "result"
